text_markup: If 2 or more unique (◆) cards with the same name are active, for each such name, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed. If 2 or more {subtype:console} cards are installed under the control of the same player, for each such player, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed.
text_plain: If 2 or more unique (◆) cards with the same name are active, for each such name, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed. If 2 or more console cards are installed under the control of the same player, for each such player, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed.
